source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.7.0, data build 963, released 2026-09-30

parts.target: An **IMPERIAL KNIGHTS** unit of yours that has not yet been **selected to shoot** in the phase.
parts.effect:
These rules apply to the unit for the rest of the phase:

- with ranged attacks of **[[BLAST]](vsdata:weapon-ability/blast)** weapons, its models can target enemy units in [Engagement Range](vsdata:core-rule/engagement-range) of it, provided such an enemy unit is not also in Engagement Range of any other unit of yours
- it ignores the [Hit roll](vsdata:core-rule/hit-rolls) penalty that being in Engagement Range of enemy units would give it
- whenever one of its models attacks a unit in Engagement Range of it with a **[[BLAST]](vsdata:weapon-ability/blast)** weapon and the Hit roll is an unmodified 1, the unit takes a [mortal wound](vsdata:core-rule/mortal-wounds) after all its attacks are resolved

data.summary:
**When:** [Your Shooting phase](vsdata:core-rule/shooting-phase).

**Target:** An **IMPERIAL KNIGHTS** unit of yours that has not yet been **selected to shoot** in the phase.

**Effect:** These rules apply to the unit for the rest of the phase:

- with ranged attacks of **[[BLAST]](vsdata:weapon-ability/blast)** weapons, its models can target enemy units in [Engagement Range](vsdata:core-rule/engagement-range) of it, provided such an enemy unit is not also in Engagement Range of any other unit of yours
- it ignores the [Hit roll](vsdata:core-rule/hit-rolls) penalty that being in Engagement Range of enemy units would give it
- whenever one of its models attacks a unit in Engagement Range of it with a **[[BLAST]](vsdata:weapon-ability/blast)** weapon and the Hit roll is an unmodified 1, the unit takes a [mortal wound](vsdata:core-rule/mortal-wounds) after all its attacks are resolved

effects.proviso: no other friendly unit is within Engagement Range of that enemy unit

effects.ignoreHitPenalty: penalty for shooting while in enemy Engagement Range

effects.resolve: after all of the unit's attacks are resolved
